answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities with a sunk cost. To register, every agent pays a $5 fee that is burned, never refunded; the receipt is a public signal of commitment, recorded crystal-clear on the ledger. A farm pouring a river of 100 fakes must burn $500 up front, while one honest agent pays $5 once and keeps its full rewards, undiluted by clones. Clones that never earn back the fee bleed money, so flooding loses money.
